stable.notes: Review Memories and Review Threads open from the panel: a list card with Refresh, and a click that opens the record full-panel with Copy as Context and Reveal in Finder for file-backed notes. Create Folders makes memory/ and threads/ so Memory and Threads never read "Setup needed" for a folder that simply does not exist yet, and the panel now shows the resolved root or the roots it tried. A complete but unused Python bridge is reported instead of sitting silent. Needs glasses-server 6.22.0.
